name: saas-kit
description: Plugin-first multi-agent SaaS development team kit for Claude Code, Antigravity, and OpenCode — 14 Senior Experts across 9 Squad Plugins.

plugins.name: saas-kit-core
plugins.description: 2-mode orchestration brain (saas-help, saas-mode), 13 lazy playbooks (incl. saas-swarm, automate-me, reflect, correct), Tech Lead, PM, QA, Security Auditor, multi-harness AgentShield hooks, and dynamic model presets.

plugins.name: saas-kit-web-frontend
plugins.description: Senior Frontend Engineer & UI/UX Designer for Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS v4, Shadcn, design systems, and Stitch/Pencil workflows.

plugins.name: saas-kit-nestjs-backend
plugins.description: Senior NestJS Backend Engineer for NestJS architecture, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL schema design, JWT auth, and OpenAPI REST/GraphQL.

plugins.name: saas-kit-python-ai
plugins.description: Senior AI Engineer & Python Backend Engineer for LangGraph, RAG, LLM evaluation, FastAPI microservices, and async Python workers.

plugins.name: saas-kit-rust-systems
plugins.description: Senior Rustacean Engineer for Tokio async runtime, Axum web services, memory safety, RTK TDD, and Tauri v2 desktop apps.

plugins.name: saas-kit-mobile-native
plugins.description: Senior Mobile Engineer for React Native New Architecture (Fabric/TurboModules), Reanimated, FlashList, iOS/Android native bridging, and Fastlane.

plugins.name: saas-kit-swift-macos
plugins.description: Senior Swift/macOS Engineer for Swift 6 strict concurrency, SwiftUI, AppKit, NSStatusItem menu bar apps, SwiftData, and Sparkle auto-update.

plugins.name: saas-kit-devops-infra
plugins.description: Senior DevOps & SRE Engineer for GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, Prometheus, Grafana, and SLO tracking.

plugins.name: saas-kit-document-office
plugins.description: Senior Document Specialist for pure-Python/Node.js DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PDF automation and local LaTeX/BibTeX compilation without LibreOffice.
